title: Measuring and mitigating overreliance is necessary for building human-compatible AI

bias_targets.methodology: Position paper reviewing historical approaches (like the judge-advisor framework, switch fraction, and weight of advice) and proposing new multi-point, outcome-focused, and holistic behavioral frameworks to measure human overreliance on AI systems.

Evaluating the tendency of models to be overly agreeable and reinforce users' existing beliefs, proposing targeted interventions and behavioral measures (e.g., source clicking, follow-up questions) to assess its contribution to overreliance.
